working_tree: main, uncommitted; earlier completed priorities preserved
scope: Complete N3 recursive-aggregation metadata stage, no recursive proof generation or runtime preissue

implementation.structure: Private immutable graph binding owns one exact registration and structural digest; tree shares its Arc
implementation.verifier_keys: Exact typed descriptor, family, native numerical source identity and profile
implementation.verifier_scope: Successful numeric plans only; original source checks, reservations, runtime recording and same_census checks remain
implementation.verifier_overflow: Uncached admitted recording; no eviction or failed result retention
implementation.arithmetic: Two canonical recipes, four-pair adjustment and inverse challenge use existing vector GPU operations
implementation.graph_topology: Values computed in vectors then exact coefficient-major scalar expression order recorded, including constant folding
implementation.memory: Fixed cache, shared registration allocation, recipe and profiling frames included in existing admission census
implementation.previous_hash_optimizations: All enabled in every comparison and ablation

limits.gpu_metadata_compiler_port: Deferred; no metadata compiler or cooperative hash kernel port

methodology.phase_medians: computed independently, may not sum to total median
methodology.fixtures: same captured and independently verified public inputs replayed by both versions
methodology.interpretation: metadata wall latency, not RingCT transaction creation or proof throughput; cache rates are software descriptor-cache rates

diagnostic_methodology: One fresh-process instrumented sample per variant, all previous hash optimizations enabled. Effects overlap and are not additive.

setup_refusal.reason: Full-profile host output allowance exceeds the 8 GiB test context. No GPU test ran; corrected smoke profile passed all six tests.
